@@ -1,2 +1,34 @@
 def proteins(strand):
-    pass
+    codon_to_aa = {
+        "AUG": "Methionine",
+        "UUU": "Phenylalanine",
+        "UUC": "Phenylalanine",
+        "UUA": "Leucine",
+        "UUG": "Leucine",
+        "UCU": "Serine",
+        "UCC": "Serine",
+        "UCA": "Serine",
+        "UCG": "Serine",
+        "UAU": "Tyrosine",
+        "UAC": "Tyrosine",
+        "UGU": "Cysteine",
+        "UGC": "Cysteine",
+        "UGG": "Tryptophan",
+        "UAA": "STOP",
+        "UAG": "STOP",
+        "UGA": "STOP",
+    }
+
+    protein = []
+    i = 0
+
+    while i < len(strand) - 2:
+        codon = strand[i : i + 3]
+        if codon in codon_to_aa:
+            aa = codon_to_aa[codon]
+            if aa == "STOP":
+                break
+            protein.append(aa)
+        i += 3
+
+    return protein
